entries.563d77a5bdefbdb9: Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥2,757,350 million, an increase of 9.9% year on year. Trading houses recognize the total consideration as revenue when they transact as principal, so revenue is a figure close to the scale of transactions and is not the company's profit itself. entries.5d873e54cd0cb465: Including profit from the trading of products, plus profit or loss from equity-method investees and other items, net income attributable to owners of the parent for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥103,611 million. By segment, net income attributable to owners of the parent is largest in Energy and Healthcare at ¥31,932 million, followed by Chemicals at ¥19,989 million and Aviation and Social Infrastructure at ¥15,506 million, an order that does not match the order of revenue. Automobiles posted a loss of ¥5,286 million, with factors cited including the recording of impairment losses in the Australian used-car business. Metals, Resources and Recycling recorded a profit of ¥4,823 million (¥29,186 million in the prior year), with factors cited including falling market conditions and lower production efficiency in the Australian metallurgical coal business, and the recording of impairment losses. The accounting standard is [[term:ifrs|IFRS]].
